metadata.title: Satyendra Nath Bose — a Bear's Notes mini-bio
metadata.style: white on near-black, grey secondary, no accent colour, Montserrat. Each beat's on-screen time = its narration length.
metadata.structure: Bear narrates throughout; visuals alternate render:clip footage (soul-id / phenomenon / application) and render:manim cards (title / equation / date).
metadata.facts: S. N. Bose 1894-1974. 1924 paper rederived Planck's law from quantum statistics; sent to Einstein, who translated + published it. Bosons named for him (Dirac). Bose-Einstein condensate predicted with Einstein (1924-25), realized 1995. Never won a Nobel.

beats.narration_text: In 1924, an unknown professor in Dhaka mailed Einstein a paper.
beats.tts_normalized_text: In nineteen twenty-four, an unknown professor in Dhaka mailed Einstein a paper.
beats.shot: Soul-ID S. N. Bose — period portrait, dim study, slow push-in.
beats.higgsfield_prompt: Cinematic period portrait of an early-20th-century Indian physicist, round glasses, dark suit, seated in a dim study with papers and books, warm low-key light, shallow depth of field, slow subtle push-in, 1920s documentary film grain, muted palette, contemplative, 5 seconds, no text

beats.narration_text: Satyendra Nath Bose had just counted light in a brand-new way.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Satyendra Nath Bose had just counted light in a brand new way.

beats.narration_text: He rederived the law of glowing heat using pure quantum statistics.
beats.tts_normalized_text: He rederived the law of glowing heat using pure quantum statistics.
beats.shot: Phenomenon — identical photons / quanta of light drifting and merging.
beats.higgsfield_prompt: slow-motion swarm of identical glowing spheres of light drifting through a dark void and merging into one bright cluster, soft blue-white glow, cinematic, shallow depth of field, 5 seconds, no text, no people

beats.narration_text: His rule counts how many identical particles crowd into each energy state.
beats.tts_normalized_text: His rule counts how many identical particles crowd into each energy state.

beats.narration_text: Particles that obey it — bosons — can pile into a single state.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Particles that obey it, bosons, can pile into a single state.
beats.shot: Application — a Bose-Einstein condensate forming (ultracold atom cloud).
beats.higgsfield_prompt: scientific visualization of an ultracold atom cloud condensing into a Bose-Einstein condensate, a single ghostly peak emerging from a cloud of scattered points, cool blue light, dark laboratory, slow zoom, cinematic, 5 seconds, no text, no people

beats.narration_text: With Einstein he predicted a new state of matter, finally made in 1995.
beats.tts_normalized_text: With Einstein he predicted a new state of matter, finally made in nineteen ninety-five.

beats.narration_text: Satyendra Nath Bose — who taught particles to share, and never won a Nobel.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Satyendra Nath Bose, who taught particles to share, and never won a Nobel.
beats.shot: Soul-ID S. N. Bose — calm closing portrait, soft light fading to dark.
